GraceUXGuidelines.Audience: Department staff and managers on desktop and mobile interfaces.
GraceUXGuidelines.Guideline: Keep navigation and action hierarchy geometrically stable; usage statistics may rank safe options but never move primary controls.
Classify adaptive controls as safe-default, rank-only, domain-derived or never-learn and preserve the stronger domain-derived or saved value.
Do not learn secrets, ACL decisions, destructive actions, arbitrary business text or stale absolute dates.
Automation must expose provenance and allow correction without destroying the original evidence.
New user flows require desktop and mobile verification when the UI is affected.
Use an Apple-inspired product language of clear hierarchy, calm density, immediate response, restrained material and continuity without copying Apple assets or screens.
For UI-scoped changes route kafedra-design to kafedra-motion, then implementation, independent kafedra-design-audit and kafedra-tests.
Motion must explain causality, orientation, direct manipulation or feedback; routine work must not receive decorative delay or conspicuous bounce.
Every material motion change keeps static state understandable and defines a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
